name: pi-bg-handoff
description: Spots long-running Bash commands and moves them to background tasks, with host-side wait tools and the background-commands skill

scripts.fork:clone: git clone https://github.com/ismailsaleekh/pi-background-tasks fork/pi-background-tasks && git clone https://github.com/AledHe/pi-agent-wait fork/pi-agent-wait
scripts.fork:pull: git -C fork/pi-background-tasks pull --ff-only && git -C fork/pi-agent-wait pull --ff-only
scripts.fork:patch: node scripts/fork-reset.mjs fork/pi-background-tasks patches/pi-background-tasks.patch src/ tests/ scripts/docs/ docs/ README.md && node scripts/fork-reset.mjs fork/pi-agent-wait patches/pi-agent-wait.patch src/ test-support/ test/
scripts.fork:patch:check: node scripts/fork-reset.mjs fork/pi-background-tasks patches/pi-background-tasks.patch --check src/ tests/ scripts/docs/ docs/ README.md && node scripts/fork-reset.mjs fork/pi-agent-wait patches/pi-agent-wait.patch --check src/ test-support/ test/
scripts.fork:patch:generate: git -C fork/pi-background-tasks add -N -- src/ tests/ scripts/docs/ docs/ README.md && git -C fork/pi-agent-wait add -N -- src/ test-support/ test/ && git -C fork/pi-background-tasks diff -- src/ tests/ scripts/docs/ docs/ README.md > patches/pi-background-tasks.patch && git -C fork/pi-agent-wait diff -- src/ test-support/ test/ > patches/pi-agent-wait.patch
scripts.fork:pristine: node scripts/fork-reset.mjs fork/pi-background-tasks patches/pi-background-tasks.patch --no-apply src/ tests/ scripts/docs/ docs/ README.md && node scripts/fork-reset.mjs fork/pi-agent-wait patches/pi-agent-wait.patch --no-apply src/ test-support/ test/
scripts.test:forks: npm --prefix fork/pi-background-tasks test && npm --prefix fork/pi-background-tasks test:docs && npm --prefix fork/pi-agent-wait test
